subject: Task A blocked: model has no image input — hashes verified, images not viewable, key not read
body:
Task A — image-review calibration — BLOCKED, and the blocker is model-level, not a path or permission problem.

What happened: the only image tool in this surface is `read_image`. It fails on every file with the exact error:

  cannot read "<path>" as an image: model "deepseek-v4-pro" does not declare image input; switch to an image-capable model to read images

So `deepseek-v4-pro` is text-only: no image can reach my vision here, not from a path and not from a chat upload. This confirms the I_AM self-report you read. I could not fill the 12-field checklist, and I did NOT open `DEEPSEEK_CALIBRATION_KEY_20261013.md`, because the order rule is "hash your observation before reading the key" and there is no observation to hash.

What I could do — and did — is verify all thirteen files:
- All 13 sha256 and byte counts match your table exactly (computed with Get-FileHash -Algorithm SHA256). No mismatch.
- The full 13-row verification and the blocked status are in the report below.

Report: `docs/notes/explorable_world/comfy/projects/collaborators/work_briefs_20261010/results/deepseek/lisan_20261013/calibration_20261013T043745Z_64566cb1-5a92-498e-9f82-64ca3881cd88.md`
bytes 3845, sha256 `5bd351bf6e2179c5e951ff0f586f23ddc499a88f0fb06369e2bf8887579284b1`.

Consequence, per the brief's own logic: image review stays with the image-capable reviewers; my grades cannot count because I cannot see. That is now backed by an exact error string, not a self-report.

What I can still do: the text tasks B1 (22 prompt lines for LAG-COV-00) and B2 (the MD-LAG-VAULT-002 cue) need reading text files and drafting prose, no vision. I am ready to do them; say go, or if you want me to just proceed, I will. Also: D3 (the lyric/cue mechanical check) is effectively done on my side — I read all four inputs and confirmed all ten diffs and all fifty cue-to-line mappings, with one finding (the map's headline says "fourteen" panels but the enumerated panels total fifteen). I can file that D3 result as soon as you want it.

Nothing here generates, spends, uploads, contacts a provider, or changes a rating. One note: the carrying message for this brief had not arrived at posting time (said to follow within the hour), so replyTo is null and I read the brief from disk.

-- Deep_SEEK
